project_license.notes: Repository has no global LICENSE. Referenced upstream notices cover borrowed portions only; do not infer ownership or distribution permission for all of Parable.

sources.scope: Narrow feedback analog polynomial and pot law port. Other UI/transfer/spline code audited; not wholesale imported.
MIT origin of feedback polynomial/pot law via PiRAT; no .NET/VST host or schematic image imported.
BYOD WDF alternative and component cross-check; no GPL code or graphics imported.
AudioLib transitive-license gap; no code imported. Bilinear substitution independently implemented.

assets.ownership_notes: Parable-local adaptations/derivations with BSD/MIT notices. Global Parable license unspecified. Circuit names identify references; no upstream graphics/assets imported. Existing provenance also pins offline ngspice and PR #11 neutral lab reuse; generic PAR-006 DSP absent.
assets.physics_notes: Nominal classic LM308/silicon RAT 100k variant reconstruction, not authenticated factory year/BOM. Finite-A followed by approximate rail/slew; idealized JFET buffer. Three component-causal prepared modes; no universal solver.
assets.behavior: Stopped preparation; bounded fixed-capacity native kernel and 4x oversampling. Healthy, diode open, Ruetz and feedback-compensation wrong-part experiment.
limitations: Full LM308 saturated-feedback recovery and JFET headroom unverified, materially important under diode-open excursions.
Exact 1N914 calibration and historical circuit revision unverified; primary ElectroSmash access blocked in PAR-007.
Supply/bias/external 30pF fault fidelity unsupported. Auditions synthetic, not founder-approved or pedal-grade.

external: C++17 standard math for DSP; host utilities only in audition runner.
ngspice 44.2 only for offline fixture regeneration; exact package pin in linked provenance.
Pinned xPack/libDaisy only for ARM build; pins/notices in firmware dependencies and ARM dependency report.

host_numerical.scope: Host checks only; independent generic signals for primitives, circuit/safety gates for LabRAT.

independent_circuit.scope: 333 finite-A preamp AC points, 576 passive clipping/Filter transient points from ngspice 44.2. Same reduced assumptions, not full-chip or physical-pedal validation.

synthetic_audition.scope: 11 synthetic 9-second PCM16 pluck/strum files; RMS matched, not LUFS matched. Founder musical approval pending. Settings/gains in renders.csv; no WAV binaries committed.

real_guitar_audition.scope: No real guitar recording or founder real-guitar listening acceptance.

arm_cross_compile.scope: Pinned Cortex-M7 object, not linked into or activated in audio firmware; 6452/0/0 object bytes, 10752-byte instance; CPU not measured.

physical_daisy.scope: No flashing, boot, callback, noise, latency, power or runtime CPU/stack measurements.

patch_runtime.scope: Outside closed patch v1 and Engine/preparation registry; no storage or live activation.
